title: McDonald’s faces a lawsuit over AI-assisted pricing guidance
friendlyTitle: A lawsuit asks who really controls AI price suggestions
summary: A proposed US class action alleges that McDonald’s AI-enhanced pricing tool and related franchise rules reduce competition among independently owned restaurants. McDonald’s says the system provides recommendations and context, while franchisees retain control of their menu prices.
friendlySummary: McDonald’s is being sued over a tool that suggests prices to franchise owners. McDonald’s says owners still decide what to charge.
whyItMatters: AI recommendations can still carry legal and commercial consequences when a powerful platform shapes decisions made by nominally independent businesses. Organisations using optimisation tools should document who controls the final decision, what constraints are applied and how recommendations are audited.
friendlyWhyItMatters: An AI suggestion can strongly influence a business even when a person makes the final choice. Companies should be clear about who controls the decision.
